name: John Thompson
bioAdditions: Pelletreau calls him 'John Thompson, Esq., of Setauket', father of Elizabeth, wife of Job Smith (S1). Weygant (1897) repeats the disproven Rev. William Thompson/Brewster story (S2).

sources.citation: W. S. Pelletreau, Records of the Town of Smithtown (1898), Appendix pp. 478-479, 'Descendants of Job Smith, Son of the Patentee' and 'Descendants of James Smith, Son of Job, 1st' (full text read on archive.org)
C. H. Weygant, The Family Record (1897; devoted to the Sackett, Weygant and Mapes families and intersecting lines), pp. 144-145, 'Smiths of Smithtown', Generations III-V
